mapper.select: SELECT id, batch_status, start_at, finished_at FROM selection_batch WHERE id = #{batchId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT batch.id FROM selection_batch batch LEFT JOIN batch_analytics_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.batch_id = batch.id AND snapshot.metric_version = #{metricVersion} WHERE batch.batch_status = 'FINISHED' AND snapshot.id IS NULL ORDER BY batch.finished_at, batch.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO batch_analytics_student_fact (batch_id, student_id, major_id, grade_year, degree_level, student_category, campus_id, building_id, room_id, bed_id, room_type, assignment_method, match_score, self_selected, team_selected, unified_allocated, unassigned, recommendation_adopted, room_changed, exchanged, waitlist_requested, waitlist_assigned, manual_adjusted, snapshot_at) WITH batch_context AS ( SELECT id, start_at, COALESCE(finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS finished_at FROM selection_batch WHERE id = #{batchId} ), ranked_residency AS ( SELECT residency.id, residency.student_id, residency.batch_id, residency.room_id, residency.bed_id, residency.assignment_method, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY residency.student_id ORDER BY residency.id DESC ) AS row_number FROM room_assignment residency JOIN batch_context batch ON residency.assigned_at <= batch.finished_at AND (residency.batch_id = batch.id OR residency.batch_id IS NULL) ), latest_residency AS ( SELECT id, student_id, batch_id, room_id, bed_id, assignment_method FROM ranked_residency WHERE row_number = 1 ), student_context AS ( SELECT eligibility.batch_id, student.id AS student_id, student.major_id, student.grade_year, student.degree_level, student.student_category, building.campus_id, building.id AS building_id, COALESCE(residency.room_id, assigned_bed.room_id) AS room_id, COALESCE(residency.bed_id, assignment.bed_id) AS bed_id, room.room_type, COALESCE(assignment.assignment_method, residency.assignment_method) AS assignment_method, assignment.allocation_run_id FROM batch_student_eligibility eligibility JOIN student ON student.id = eligibility.student_id JOIN batch_context batch ON batch.id = eligibility.batch_id LEFT JOIN bed_assignment assignment ON assignment.batch_id = eligibility.batch_id AND assignment.student_id = student.id AND assignment.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN latest_residency residency ON residency.student_id = student.id LEFT JOIN bed assigned_bed ON assigned_bed.id = assignment.bed_id LEFT JOIN room ON room.id = COALESCE(residency.room_id, assigned_bed.room_id) LEFT JOIN dormitory_floor floor ON floor.id = room.floor_id LEFT JOIN dormitory_building building ON building.id = floor.building_id WHERE eligibility.eligibility_status = 'ELIGIBLE' ), allocation_score AS ( SELECT result.allocation_run_id, result.student_id, result.bed_id, MAX(result.score) AS score FROM allocation_run_result result JOIN student_context context ON context.allocation_run_id = result.allocation_run_id AND context.student_id = result.student_id AND context.bed_id = result.bed_id GROUP BY result.allocation_run_id, result.student_id, result.bed_id ), optimization_score AS ( SELECT run.batch_id, candidate.student_id, candidate.bed_id, MAX(candidate.score) AS score FROM allocation_optimization_run run JOIN allocation_optimization_candidate candidate ON candidate.run_id = run.id JOIN student_context context ON context.batch_id = run.batch_id AND context.student_id = candidate.student_id AND context.bed_id = candidate.bed_id WHERE run.run_status = 'SUBMITTED' GROUP BY run.batch_id, candidate.student_id, candidate.bed_id ), recommendation_fact AS ( SELECT request.batch_id, request.student_id, MAX(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(request.response_json, '$.matchScore')) AS DECIMAL(10,4))) AS score, 1 AS recommendation_adopted FROM student_recommendation_request request JOIN student_context context ON context.batch_id = request.batch_id AND context.student_id = request.student_id JOIN batch_context batch ON batch.id = request.batch_id WHERE request.created_at <= batch.finished_at AND ( CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(request.response_json, '$.bed.id')) AS UNSIGNED) = context.bed_id OR CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(request.response_json, '$.room.id')) AS UNSIGNED) = context.room_id ) GROUP BY request.batch_id, request.student_id ), room_change_fact AS ( SELECT source_residency.batch_id, request.student_id, 1 AS room_changed FROM room_change_request request JOIN room_assignment source_residency ON source_residency.id = request.source_residency_id JOIN batch_context batch ON batch.id = source_residency.batch_id WHERE request.request_status = 'EXECUTED' AND request.executed_at <= batch.finished_at GROUP BY source_residency.batch_id, request.student_id ), exchange_events AS ( SELECT initiator_source.batch_id, request.initiator_student_id AS student_id FROM room_exchange_request request JOIN room_assignment initiator_source ON initiator_source.id = request.initiator_residency_id JOIN batch_context batch ON batch.id = initiator_source.batch_id WHERE request.request_status = 'EXECUTED' AND request.executed_at <= batch.finished_at UNION ALL SELECT target_source.batch_id, request.target_student_id AS student_id FROM room_exchange_request request JOIN room_assignment target_source ON target_source.id = request.target_residency_id JOIN batch_context batch ON batch.id = target_source.batch_id WHERE request.request_status = 'EXECUTED' AND request.executed_at <= batch.finished_at ), exchange_fact AS ( SELECT batch_id, student_id, 1 AS exchanged FROM exchange_events GROUP BY batch_id, student_id ), waitlist_fact AS ( SELECT context.batch_id, context.student_id, MAX(CASE WHEN waitlist.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitlist_requested, MAX(CASE WHEN waitlist.entry_status = 'ASSIGNED' AND waitlist.assigned_at BETWEEN batch.start_at AND batch.finished_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitlist_assigned FROM student_context context JOIN batch_context batch ON batch.id = context.batch_id LEFT JOIN waitlist_entry waitlist ON waitlist.student_id = context.student_id AND waitlist.joined_at BETWEEN batch.start_at AND batch.finished_at GROUP BY context.batch_id, context.student_id ) SELECT context.batch_id, context.student_id, context.major_id, context.grade_year, context.degree_level, context.student_category, context.campus_id, context.building_id, context.room_id, context.bed_id, context.room_type, context.assignment_method, COALESCE(allocation_score.score, optimization_score.score, recommendation_fact.score), CASE WHEN context.assignment_method IN ('SELF_SELECT','STUDENT_RANDOM','ROOM_SELECT','BED_SELECT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN context.assignment_method IN ('TEAM_SELECT','TEAM_ROOM_SELECT','TEAM_BED_SELECT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN context.assignment_method IN ('ADMIN_RANDOM','ADMIN_OPTIMIZED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN context.room_id IS NULL AND context.bed_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(recommendation_fact.recommendation_adopted, 0), COALESCE(room_change_fact.room_changed, 0), COALESCE(exchange_fact.exchanged, 0), COALESCE(waitlist_fact.waitlist_requested, 0), COALESCE(waitlist_fact.waitlist_assigned, 0), CASE WHEN context.assignment_method IN ('MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT','DIRECT_ROOM','DIRECT_BED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{snapshotAt} FROM student_context context LEFT JOIN allocation_score ON allocation_score.allocation_run_id = context.allocation_run_id AND allocation_score.student_id = context.student_id AND allocation_score.bed_id = context.bed_id LEFT JOIN optimization_score ON optimization_score.batch_id = context.batch_id AND optimization_score.student_id = context.student_id AND optimization_score.bed_id = context.bed_id LEFT JOIN recommendation_fact ON recommendation_fact.batch_id = context.batch_id AND recommendation_fact.student_id = context.student_id LEFT JOIN room_change_fact ON room_change_fact.batch_id = context.batch_id AND room_change_fact.student_id = context.student_id LEFT JOIN exchange_fact ON exchange_fact.batch_id = context.batch_id AND exchange_fact.student_id = context.student_id LEFT JOIN waitlist_fact ON waitlist_fact.batch_id = context.batch_id AND waitlist_fact.student_id = context.student_id
mapper.select: WITH fact_metrics AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS participant_count, COALESCE(SUM(self_selected), 0) AS self_selection_count, COALESCE(SUM(team_selected), 0) AS team_selection_count, COALESCE(SUM(unified_allocated), 0) AS unified_allocation_count, COALESCE(SUM(unassigned), 0) AS unassigned_count, COALESCE(SUM(recommendation_adopted), 0) AS recommendation_adoption_count, COALESCE(AVG(match_score), 0) AS average_match_score, COALESCE(MIN(match_score), 0) AS minimum_match_score, COALESCE(SUM(room_changed), 0) AS room_change_count, COALESCE(SUM(exchanged), 0) AS exchange_count, COALESCE(SUM(waitlist_requested), 0) AS waitlist_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(waitlist_assigned), 0) AS waitlist_assignment_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN unassigned = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS assigned_count FROM batch_analytics_student_fact WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ), eligibility_metrics AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS student_total FROM batch_student_eligibility WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ), history_metrics AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS manual_adjustment_count FROM assignment_history WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND event_type = 'ADJUSTED' ), scope_room_ids AS ( SELECT room_id FROM batch_room_scope WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} UNION SELECT bed.room_id FROM batch_bed_scope scope JOIN bed ON bed.id = scope.bed_id WHERE scope.batch_id = #{batchId} UNION SELECT room.id FROM batch_building_scope scope JOIN dormitory_floor floor ON floor.building_id = scope.building_id JOIN room ON room.floor_id = floor.id WHERE scope.batch_id = #{batchId} ), capacity_metrics AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(room.capacity), 0) AS total_capacity FROM room JOIN scope_room_ids scope ON scope.room_id = room.id ), timing_metrics AS ( SELECT COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, COALESCE(published_at, created_at), finished_at), 0) AS completion_duration_seconds FROM selection_batch WHERE id = #{batchId} ) SELECT eligibility_metrics.student_total, fact_metrics.participant_count, fact_metrics.self_selection_count, fact_metrics.team_selection_count, fact_metrics.unified_allocation_count, fact_metrics.unassigned_count, fact_metrics.recommendation_adoption_count, fact_metrics.average_match_score, fact_metrics.minimum_match_score, fact_metrics.room_change_count, fact_metrics.exchange_count, fact_metrics.waitlist_request_count, fact_metrics.waitlist_assignment_count, history_metrics.manual_adjustment_count, CASE WHEN capacity_metrics.total_capacity = 0 THEN 0 ELSE fact_metrics.assigned_count * 1.0 / capacity_metrics.total_capacity END AS bed_utilization_rate, timing_metrics.completion_duration_seconds FROM fact_metrics CROSS JOIN eligibility_metrics CROSS JOIN history_metrics CROSS JOIN capacity_metrics CROSS JOIN timing_metrics
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_analytics_snapshot (batch_id, metric_version, metrics_json, dimensions_json, source_basis, data_updated_at, immutable) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{metricVersion}, CAST(#{metricsJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{dimensionsJson} AS JSON), 'BATCH_FINAL_RESULT', #{updatedAt}, 1)
